items.markdown:
Kanchanaburi, located 70 miles (110 km) northwest of Bangkok , is `a scenic province famous for the River Kwai and the historical "Death Railway" built during World War II` . It offers a poignant mix of poignant history, lush jungle landscapes, and unique floating river accommodations.[](https://www.audleytravel.com/thailand/places-to-go/kanchanaburi-and-the-river-kwai) [[1]](https://www.audleytravel.com/thailand/places-to-go/kanchanaburi-and-the-river-kwai)[[2]](https://www.britannica.com/place/Kanchanaburi)[[3]](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attraction_Review-g297924-d554151-Reviews-River_Kwai-Kanchanaburi_Kanchanaburi_Province.html)[[4]](https://www.thefloathouseriverkwai.com/)[[5]](https://www.wendywutours.co.uk/thailand/kanchanaburi/river-kwai/)[[6]](https://www.riverkwairesotel.net/)

Key Attractions

- **The Bridge on the River Kwai:** The iconic curved steel bridge is the most recognizable landmark in the area. It was part of the infamous 415-kilometer railway built by Allied prisoners of War (POWs) for the Japanese. You can walk across it and even take a train along the surviving portions of the tracks.[](https://www.audleytravel.com/thailand/places-to-go/kanchanaburi-and-the-river-kwai) [[1]](https://www.takemetour.com/landmark/river-kwai-bridge)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8Ss3z-F1VXY)
- **Death Railway & Hellfire Pass:** To dive deeper into the history, visit the Hellfire Pass Interpretive Centre, which details the grueling conditions POWs endured carving through the mountain rock.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dTpKuw-c9ls&t=23) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dTpKuw-c9ls&t=23)[[2]](https://www.riverkwairesotel.net/kanchanaburi-blog/the-ultimate-school-break-guide-6-unmissable-family-landmarks-jungle-adventures-at-river-kwai-resotel/)
- **War Cemeteries:** The [Kanchanaburi War Cemetery](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Attraction/bridge-over-the-river-kwai) (Don Rak) is the resting place for over 6,000 Allied POWs.[](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Attraction/bridge-over-the-river-kwai) [[1]](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Attraction/bridge-over-the-river-kwai)

Accommodation & Stays A major draw of the River Kwai is the ability to stay directly on the water. Popular floating resorts offer a tranquil, immersive jungle experience:

- **[The Float House River Kwai](https://www.thefloathouseriverkwai.com/)** : A luxury floating boutique resort surrounded by lush greenery.
- **[River Kwai Resotel](https://www.riverkwairesotel.net/)** : Nestled along the river and accessible only by boat, perfect for nature discovery and soft adventures.[](https://www.thefloathouseriverkwai.com/) [[1]](https://we-offers.com/product/the-float-house-river-kwai-resort/)[[2]](https://www.ticket2attraction.com/blogs/kanchanaburi-attraction/)

Getting There You can reach Kanchanaburi from Bangkok via a scenic 2 to 3-hour journey:

- **Train:** A daily line runs from Bangkok's Thon Buri Station to Kanchanaburi and on to the Nam Tok waterfall.
- **Road:** Taxis, minivans, and buses operate regularly from Bangkok's Southern Bus Terminal.[](https://www.takemetour.com/landmark/river-kwai-bridge) [[1]](https://www.takemetour.com/landmark/river-kwai-bridge)[[2]](https://www.thailandtrains.com/kanchanaburi-line-timetable/)[[3]](https://www.hintokrivercamp.com/how-to-get-here/by-train/)
